item.title: Jinko ESS Collaborates with ComAp on Energy Storage Applications
item.description: Jinko ESS, the energy storage arm of Jinko Solar Co., Ltd., has announced a technical compatibility collaboration with ComAp to integrate its commercial and industrial (C&I) energy storage systems with ComAp’s energy management and control platforms. item.title: EU Solar Output Tops 340 TWh in 2025, Lifting Renewables to Nearly Half of Power Mix
item.description: Renewables accounted for close to half of electricity generation in the European Union (EU) in 2025, marking a shift from a marginal role to a system-defining position. item.title: Ola Electric Begins Deliveries of Shakti Home Battery
item.description: Ola Electric has begun deliveries of its Ola Shakti residential battery energy storage system, marking the commercial rollout of what the company claims is India’s first domestically engineered and manufactured home battery solution powered by 4680 Bharat Cells. The company said deliveries of the 6 kW / 9.1 kWh variant commenced in Bengaluru on Saturday and will be scaled up across other parts of the country in the coming months. item.title: Tata Power Renewable Commissions 198 MW Group Captive Wind Project in Tamil Nadu
item.description: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL) has commissioned a 198 MW wind energy project for Tata Steel under the group captive model in Karur, Tamil Nadu, marking one of the largest wind projects of its kind in the state. Located in Karur, the project comprises 55 wind turbine generators, each with a capacity of 3.6 MW. item.description: The Lucknow Solar Power Development Corporation Limited (LSPDCL) has issued a request for proposal to raise a ₹30 crore term loan to fund infrastructure development for two solar power parks in Uttar Pradesh.
